title: The records-page guard accepts a main merge whose docs/records.md differs only by derived rows the merge tool rebuilds
why: Coordinator 15:01 CST Nov 12: lane fan-code-workflows merging main into #2737 hit the records-page guard; its remedy (take main's docs/records.md) is denied by the auto-mode classifier as irreversible local destruction, so a lane merging main is stuck by design (rule verification-cry-wolf-guard-is-spent). Owner item 647 asks for an override meanwhile.
note: Accept the merge when records.md differs from main only by derived rows the merge tool rebuilds at merge; or give a remedy the classifier allows. Red first on #2737's merge. A guard verdict change: round 3 gets the net-value test. Unblocks the four PRs if item 647 picks b.
